description: This file handles the saving and updating of ACLRoles within the SuiteCRM system, including creating new roles, duplicating existing roles, assigning permissions, and redirecting after completion.

classes.name: ACLRoles
classes.description: The ACLRole class representing user roles with access control levels in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Persists the ACLRole data to the database.

methods.name: getRoleActions
methods.description: Retrieves the list of actions assigned to a role.

methods.name: setAction
methods.description: Assigns a specific action with a certain access level to the role.
